description: Search Macy's by keyword, browse a department/category listing, or fetch full product detail by ID.

brand.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the product brand (e.g. `Nike`, `Ralph Lauren`).
brand.title: Brand contains

categoryPath.description: A Macy's category/department path. Pick a common one from the dropdown-style examples below, or paste any `macys.com/shop/...` category URL / path.
categoryPath.title: Category path (mode=category)

excludeSponsored.description: Macy's interleaves paid-placement ("featured") tiles into search/category listings that ignore the requested sort order (e.g. a pricier sponsored item can appear mid-way through a Price: Low to High sort). Enable to drop these and keep only organically-ranked/sorted results.
excludeSponsored.title: Exclude sponsored/featured items

includeReviews.description: When true, `product` mode also emits a `reviews[]` array (author, date, title, text, rating) parsed from the product page's review data. Off by default to keep records compact.
includeReviews.title: Include customer reviews (mode=product)

maxPrice.description: Drop products priced above this amount.
maxPrice.title: Max price (USD)

minPrice.description: Drop products priced below this amount.
minPrice.title: Min price (USD)

minRating.description: Drop products with a review rating below this value.
minRating.title: Min rating (0-5)

enumTitles: Lookup full product detail by ID
mode.title: Mode

onSaleOnly.description: Only emit products that are currently discounted from an original price.
onSaleOnly.title: On-sale only

productIds.description: Macy's numeric product IDs (e.g. `20663500`) or full product page URLs.
productIds.title: Product IDs / URLs (mode=product)

searchQuery.description: Free-text keyword search (mode=search), e.g. `womens dresses`, `running shoes`, `mens suit`.
searchQuery.title: Search query

title: Macy's Scraper Input
